lease_file.description: Absolute path to the ISC DHCP server lease database file.

html_output_dir.description: Directory where HTML reports are generated. Set to empty string '' to disable.

csv_output_dir.description: Directory where CSV reports are generated. Set to empty string '' to disable.

json_output_dir.description: Directory where JSON reports are generated. Set to empty string '' to disable.

report_date_format.description: Date/time format used in report headers and timestamps (Python strptime syntax).

recent_days.description: Number of days into the past considered 'recent' for activity analysis.

stale_days.description: Minimum number of days since last activity before a lease is flagged as 'stale'.

detailed_subnets.description: Whether to include per-subnet statistics (more accurate but heavier on large files).

exclude_subnets.description: List of subnet CIDR or dotted-quad ranges to exclude from analysis.

items.description: A subnet in CIDR notation (e.g., 192.168.1.0/24) or dotted-quad (e.g., 192.168.1.0).

include_subnets.description: If non-empty, only these subnets are analyzed (others ignored). Leave empty to include all.

items.description: A subnet in CIDR or dotted-quad notation to include.

thresholds.description: Thresholds for warning and critical alerts across different metrics.

pool_warn_pct.description: Pool usage % above which warning is triggered.

pool_crit_pct.description: Pool usage % above which critical alert is triggered.

stale_warn_count.description: Number of stale leases above which warning is triggered.

stale_crit_count.description: Number of stale leases above which critical alert is triggered.

active_warn_count.description: Total active leases above which warning is triggered.

active_crit_count.description: Total active leases above which critical alert is triggered.

reports.description: Toggle for optional sections included in reports.

pool_stats.description: Include per-pool statistics (address usage, ranges, counts).

class_stats.description: Include per-class statistics (DHCP classes, vendor options, etc.).

host_reservations.description: Include static host reservations in reports.

mac_vendor_lookup.description: Look up MAC OUI to human-readable vendor (adds processing time).

time_series.description: Include trend/time-series analysis (requires multiple report runs and retention of reports).
